svg.title: Amazon SNS
svg.desc: Amazon SNS. Managed publish-subscribe: a message published to a topic fans out to queues, functions, HTTP endpoints, email and SMS. Step 1, Where it sits: Orders publishes OrderPlaced once; SNS pushes a copy to every subscription whose filter matches. Step 2, Publish and filter: Stored in several AZs before the 200. Filters: 640 passes fraud-check (≥ 500), not the SMS (≥ 5000). Step 3, Delivery and retries: The partner answers 503: 3 retries, 20 s apart, then partner-dlq. Delivery is at least once. Step 4, No archive, FIFO, limits: No archive: a later subscriber misses earlier messages. FIFO topics order, dedupe and can replay.
